map.：体表损伤较轻，内部损伤严重（皮肤完整但内脏破裂）: external surface injury is relatively mild while internal injury is severe (skin intact but viscera ruptured)
map.：全身多部位损伤，常涉及多系统: injuries at many sites across the body, often involving multiple systems
map.：颅骨、脊椎、骨盆、四肢骨折: skull, spine, pelvis and limb fractures
map.：着地部位冲击伤，对侧对冲伤（如枕部着地→额颞叶对冲伤）: impact injury at the landing site with a countercoup injury on the opposite side (for example occipital landing leading to frontal-temporal countercoup injury)
map.：损伤分布与坠落方向一致，可推断着地姿势: the injury distribution matches the direction of the fall and can be used to infer the landing posture

map.：颅骨骨折（多为环形/凹陷性）、颅底骨折、脑挫裂伤（着力点+对冲伤）、颈椎骨折脱: skull fracture (mostly ring / depressed), skull base fracture, cerebral contusion and laceration (impact point plus countercoup), cervical fracture and dislocation
map.：跟骨/距骨骨折、胫腓骨骨折、髋臼骨折、骨盆骨折、脊椎压缩性骨折（传递性损伤）: calcaneal or talar fracture, tibia and fibula fracture, acetabular fracture, pelvic fracture, spinal compression fracture (transmitted injury)
map.：骨盆骨折、骶骨骨折、腰椎压缩性骨折、内脏破裂（肝脾破裂）: pelvic fracture, sacral fracture, lumbar compression fracture, visceral rupture (liver and spleen rupture)
map.：肋骨骨折（多为连枷胸）、肺挫伤、肝/脾破裂（视着地侧）: rib fracture (mostly flail chest), pulmonary contusion, liver or spleen rupture (depending on the landing side)
map.严重骨折、内脏破裂、颅脑伤: Severe fracture, visceral rupture, craniocerebral injury

map.落地姿势对损伤影响大吗？: Does landing posture greatly affect injury?
map.很大。足先落地能量沿下肢传导（跟骨/脊柱/颅底），头先落地直接颅脑伤，侧身着地多: Yes. Landing on the feet transmits energy up the lower limbs (calcaneus, spine, skull base), landing on the head produces direct craniocerebral injury, and landing on the side commonly breaks ribs. Posture determines injury distribution.
